assumption_sources.label: Weather
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default: dataset terdekat yang tersedia, atau site referensi bila belum ada (diberi peringatan WEATHER_REFERENCE_SITE). HelioScope: Choosing a Weather File.

assumption_sources.label: Lokasi sudut matahari
assumption_sources.source: ADR-0005: posisi matahari dan irradiance berasal dari satu tempat, yaitu lokasi file weather.

assumption_sources.label: Model transposisi
assumption_sources.source: Perez et al. (1990), default pvlib (ENG-09). Hay-Davies dan isotropik tersedia.

assumption_sources.label: Dekomposisi GHI
assumption_sources.source: Perez et al. (1992) DIRINT, default pvlib (ENG-09). Erbs tersedia.

assumption_sources.label: Model IAM (pantulan)
assumption_sources.source: De Soto (2006), konfigurasi oracle #2 (ENG-09). ASHRAE, Martin-Ruiz, dan profil PAN tersedia.

assumption_sources.label: Koefisien b0 ASHRAE
assumption_sources.source: Dipakai hanya bila iam = ashrae; default pvlib 0,05 (ENG-09).

assumption_sources.label: Koefisien a_r Martin-Ruiz
assumption_sources.source: Dipakai hanya bila iam = martin_ruiz; default pvlib 0,16 (ENG-09).

assumption_sources.label: Profil IAM PAN
assumption_sources.source: Dipakai hanya bila iam = pan_profile; titik [aoi, faktor] dari karakterisasi (#9).

assumption_sources.label: IAM difus
assumption_sources.source: Paritas oracle pvlib (#2): tidak ada rugi difus; Marion 2017 tersedia (ENG-09).

assumption_sources.label: Albedo
assumption_sources.source: Albedo tipikal desain C&I HelioScope 0,2 (Typical Loss Factors). BUKAN nilai pvlib oracle; ditinjau per lokasi.

assumption_sources.label: Albedo dari weather
assumption_sources.source: Default memakai albedo bulanan; kolom albedo weather dipakai bila diaktifkan (#12).

assumption_sources.label: Koreksi spektral
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope hanya menerapkannya untuk thin film; default engine nonaktif (ENG-09).

assumption_sources.label: Teknologi sel spektral
assumption_sources.source: Default mono-Si; koefisien First Solar (Lee & Panchula 2016).

assumption_sources.label: Precipitable water dari weather
assumption_sources.source: Default Gueymard 1994 dari suhu+RH; kolom weather dipakai bila diaktifkan (ENG-09).

assumption_sources.label: Soiling
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope Typical Loss Factors: soiling default 2%

assumption_sources.label: Mismatch modul
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope Typical Loss Factors: mismatch ~2%

assumption_sources.label: Kabel DC
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default: dihitung dari konduktor di #41. Rentang tipikal HelioScope 0 sampai -2% (Typical Loss Factors).

assumption_sources.label: Efisiensi inverter datar
assumption_sources.source: PVWatts v5: inverter standar 96% (HelioScope Versus PV Watts)

assumption_sources.label: Kabel AC dan trafo
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default: derate AC Losses di condition set HelioScope dipakai bila sistem AC tidak didesain; dihitung di #41 dan #64.

assumption_sources.label: LID awal
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope tidak memasang LID secara default (Adding Custom Losses, diakses 2026-10-27); PVWatts v5 memakai 1,5%. Bila diisi, LID menjadi baris loss tree sendiri (#53).

assumption_sources.label: Degradasi tahunan
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope Typical Loss Factors: rentang degradasi tipikal 0,25-0,75 %/tahun (diakses 2026-10-27); HelioScope, What are Under-Voltage Losses?: loss daya karena degradasi keluar dari tegangan (diakses 2026-10-27); HelioScope Does HelioScope Account for Module Degradation? https://help-center.helioscope.com/hc/en-us/articles/8317074447123 (diakses 2026-10-27).
assumption_sources.value: tahun pertama 0%, laju 0.5%/tahun compound, 100% ke tegangan

assumption_sources.label: Ketidaktersediaan sistem
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope tidak menghitung availability secara default (How to Account for Availability: 0%). PVWatts memakai 3%.

assumption_sources.label: Loss tambahan
assumption_sources.source: Maksimum 5, diisi pengguna (Adding Custom Losses).

assumption_sources.label: Model suhu sel
assumption_sources.source: Preset HelioScope per racking, pvlib TEMPERATURE_MODEL_PARAMETERS['sapm'] (King et al. 2004, SAND2004-3535), ADR-0018.

assumption_sources.label: Koefisien suhu daya
assumption_sources.source: Urutan: karakterisasi modul, condition set, bawaan PVWatts v5 Premium (Dobos 2014) dengan peringatan, ADR-0018.

assumption_sources.label: Karakterisasi modul
assumption_sources.source: Dipilih dari karakterisasi SKU organisasi (#9).

assumption_sources.label: Karakterisasi inverter
assumption_sources.source: Dipilih dari karakterisasi SKU organisasi (#9).

assumption_sources.label: Batas daya AC manual
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default: batas pelanggan atau jaringan. HelioScope Hourly Production Report CSV menyebut AC Power Limit sebagai pembatas di luar aplikasi (https://help-center.helioscope.com/hc/en-us/articles/8536799301523, diakses 2026-10-24).

assumption_sources.label: Batas daya semu
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default: rating daya semu inverter/sistem. HelioScope Inverter Focus - Nominal and Apparent Power (https://help-center.helioscope.com/hc/en-us/articles/8536640508307, diakses 2026-10-24).

assumption_sources.label: Faktor daya
assumption_sources.source: Paritas HelioScope: reactive power tidak dimodelkan, jadi PF 1,0 (Inverter Focus, diakses 2026-10-24).

assumption_sources.label: Setpoint daya reaktif
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa default; alternatif PF. P_max = sqrt(S^2 - Q^2) (Inverter Focus, diakses 2026-10-24).

assumption_sources.label: Offset suhu inverter
assumption_sources.source: Tanpa offset: suhu ambien weather dipakai apa adanya. Offset pemasangan diisi pengguna bila inverter berada di ruang lebih panas.

assumption_sources.label: Kurva derating termal inverter
assumption_sources.source: Kurva [T_amb_C, P_max_pct] dari datasheet atau OND (TPNom/TPLim1/TPLimAbs); tanpa kurva tidak ada derating termal.

assumption_sources.label: Sumber kurva derating termal
assumption_sources.source: Wajib bila kurva datasheet diisi (ADR-0004).

assumption_sources.label: Model bifacial
assumption_sources.source: HelioScope Bifacial Modules: new condition sets default on, rear mismatch 10%, rear shading factor 5%, module transparency 0% (diakses 2026-10-22).
assumption_sources.value: aktif; rear mismatch 10%, rear shading 5%, transparency 0%
